noun_definition: Group refers to a chat entity created within the application that allows multiple users to send messages to each other.
Loading refers to the delay experienced when the user attempts to navigate back after leaving a group, resulting in no response from the application.
User refers to an individual who interacts with the application by logging in, creating a group, sending messages, and performing actions related to group membership.
Back arrow refers to the navigation button that allows the user to return to the previous screen after leaving a group chat.
